message: Magic Control Pro v2.4 is available with Force, corrected permanent-note dates, automatic Notes cache refresh and native-style note navigation.
notes: Magic Control Pro v2.4 adds the standalone Force PWA at /force, six independent Force-enabled seed notes, hidden per-note list setup, persistent swap commands, local acknowledgements and the approved F app icon. Permanent Notes preserve their manual edit time while displaying a date consistent with Yesterday, Previous 7 Days, Previous 30 Days or their fixed month. Opening a note now slides the editor in from the right over a stationary list, while Back slides it out to the right. Notes replace stale PWA resources automatically while preserving localStorage, Force lists, selected values, language, theme and user-created notes. Existing Magic Control, Calculator, Peek, Wi-Fi/AP, beacon, BOOT, OLED and OTA architecture are preserved.
